notes:
I don't have any notes for you yet. Nothing I fetched made it into a form I could read, so I have no sourced material for any verse of Jeremiah 20.

I sent requests for six pages at once:
- https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/jeremiah-20/
- https://www.preceptaustin.org/jeremiah-20-commentary
- the biblehub.com commentary pages for Jeremiah 20:1, 20:7, 20:9 and 20:14 (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit and others)

The results came back in a different format than my script expected, and it crashed before saving or showing any page text. When I tried to re-read the results, the tool told me I had no more calls left for this turn. So I never saw what any of those pages say.

Your rules say to report only what I've actually read, with a link for each point, and not to fill gaps from memory. Writing notes on Pashhur's new name "Magor-missabib" (v. 3), "You have deceived me" (v. 7), the "fire shut up in my bones" (v. 9) or the curse on the day he was born (vv. 14–18) right now would break that, so I've left them out.

If you ask me to continue in a new message, my tool calls should be available again. I would then:
1. Re-fetch the pages above, plus the remaining verse pages on biblehub and studylight (vv. 2–18).
2. Search the tradition-specific sites for where views differ, especially v. 7 (what "deceived" means), v. 9 (the inner call to preach) and vv. 14–18 (whether a believer may lament like this). That includes desiringgod.org, gty.org, ligonier.org, thegospelcoalition.org, wesley.nnu.edu, seedbed.com, 1517.org and lcms.org.
3. Check netbible.org's translation notes and bibleodyssey.org for modern scholarship, and newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org for Catholic and Orthodox readings.
4. Write the notes verse by verse in your "v. 4: …" format, with the URL after each point, leaving out anything I can't find.
